Name: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Farmer
Author: heartolazor
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Be a Poke[/b][b]mon in Stardew Valley![/b][/size][/center][center][youtube]VnRC_RbjUAI[/youtube][/center]
Pokemon Mystery Dungeon replacement sprites for Fashion Sense.
Replaces Farmer body with ANY Pokemon from [url=https://sprites.pmdcollab.org/]Pokemon Mystery Dungeon sprite repository[/url]!
The main idea is to play with a pokemon instead of a boring farmer and make the PMD sprite repository (mystery dungeon format) compatible with stardew valley, so this opens the door to custom OCS or [i]pokesonas[/i].

[b][size=5]Usage Instructions:[/size]
[/b][size=3][b]1 - Install one of the versions of the mod, there are two available for now:[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]All variants: all pokemon sprites and variations are available, including shinnies, galar, etc.
[*]Skip variants: Only the base pokemon is available.
[/list] ﻿Because of the sheer amount of pokemons and variations and how [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/issues/51]Fashion Sense manages the sprite loading in GPU memory[/url]﻿, the requirements for video memory can be somewhat high in low end computers, so try the all variations and if the game doesn't load after some minutes try the skip variations, as reference the skip variations has approximately 1000 spritesheets and the all variations has at least 5000.
[b][size=3]2 - Select your pokemon.[/size][/b]
﻿Because of the sheer amount of pokemons I recommend to use Fashion Sense's Search and use tags to filter by pokemon name, Gen or number
[b][size=3]3 - Select the invisible accesories, hats, etc.[/size][/b]
﻿In the non body parts there is a new skins included in the mod which are invisible, for example Invisible Hat, Invisible Accesory, Invisible shoes, etc. I recommend to choose them because of the body differences between pokemon and farmer, it's impossible to match the shirts for example.
[size=3][b]4 - Configure the color filter of the body.[/b]
In the body section, configure the color filter at the botto, until the sprite is not dark.[/size]

Here is a video that shows how to configure the mod invisible parts and selecting the pokemon:
[youtube]-UZJP_m8uUA[/youtube]

[i]Credits for all the sprites to their respective [url=https://sprites.pmdcollab.org/#/?creditsMode=true]creators[/url]. The credits are included in each pokemon folder as credits.txt. I, [b][url=https://linktr.ee/HeartoLazor]Hearto Lazor[/url][/b], developed a program to port them automatically to the Fashion Sense format.

[b][size=3]If you like my work and you want to support me to develop more awesome mods or projects, [/size][/b][url=https://ko-fi.com/hearto][b][size=3]you can buy me a coffee on Ko-Fi![/size][/b][/url][/i]

[size=5][b]Generator Source Code:
[/b][/size]
Here is the source code of the generator (doesn't include any pokemon, but can be used to reconstruct this mod, make improvements in the generation or generate custom pokemon OCS from the pokemon mystery dungeon sprite format):
[url=https://github.com/HeartoLazor/PokemonMysteryDungeonFarmerGenerator]https://github.com/HeartoLazor/PokemonMysteryDungeonFarmerGenerator
[/url]There are instruction about how it works in that github page.

There is [url=https://github.com/HeartoLazor/StardewValleyPMDFarmerSprites]another repository[/url] with the generated sprites in all formats and the debug sprites generated by the generator --debug-frames command argument, which outputs the Stardew generated spritesheet and the pokemon mystery dungeon frames used to create the Stardew Spritesheet with transparent background color changed to a solid color. You can use that for a guide of which frames you need to edit in the original sprite from [url=https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab/tree/master/sprite]https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab/tree/master/sprite[/url] to create your Custom OC, when you have all the frames edited you can follow the instruction available at the github repository of the generator source code. Remember to update the Shadow.png and Offsets.png if you change where the legs are placed in the original sprite, more information about this topic here: [url=https://wiki.pmdo.pmdcollab.org/Tutorial:PMD_Sprite_Format]https://wiki.pmdo.pmdcollab.org/Tutorial:PMD_Sprite_Format[/url]
